name: smart-fuel
title: Smart Fuel
author: Crosstowndonkey
description: Furnaces, boilers, burner drills and inserters, locomotives, cars, heating towers, nuclear reactors and biochambers keep themselves fuelled: construction robots bring fuel from the logistic network (the hub on space platforms). Vehicles get the best fuel; machines get the most plentiful basic fuel and never your rocket or nuclear fuel.
